name.ja: Shu–Osher：特性WENO-Zと高解像度参照：参照・検証
name.en: Shu–Osher: characteristic WENO-Z and a numerical reference — references and checks

note.ja: 高解像度の保存変数の点値を各100/200点の格子中心へ線形補間する。誤差はそれぞれ同じ場所・t=1.8で平均する。CSVは200点の計算・参照を並べる。近似収支の許容値0.2%は固定境界の離散化誤差を許すためであり、密度誤差0.15の判定とは別。
note.en: Higher-resolution conserved point values are linearly interpolated to each 100/200-point grid's centers. Errors are averaged at matching locations and t=1.8; CSV pairs the 200-point solution and reference. The 0.2% approximate-balance allowance accommodates fixed-boundary discretization and is separate from the density-error bound of 0.15.
